title: Coherent strict quotient normalization of the transported completed tensor
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W. Let S be a coefficient derived system calculus and rho its normalized total-limit/Roos comparison [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Construct tensorModelRealization by taking the uniquely strict-Roos-normalized pullbackTensorIntegralTensorModel [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], then transport its two reduction functors through the unique unit-compatible comparison of left adjoints to the same total limit, and its closed tensor through the canonical transpose-preserving comparison [lem-coef-closed-tensor-comparison]. This explicitly constructed natural isomorphism satisfies IsTensorModelNormalized [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]: on every pair of whole-system coherent good strict quotient presentations it has the prescribed local homogeneous tensor formula and the stated whole-system Roos equation. No residue-characteristic, boundedness or constructibility hypothesis on the inputs is needed.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; tensor realization portion of original steps 4 and 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence. Whole-system coherence is the same correction already made for scalar/pullback models.

proof.text: Use the uniquely normalized reference tensor realization and its strict quotient/Roos factorization. Its defining comparison is a natural isomorphism on pairs of good representatives and fixes the actual tensor tower, not just evaluated objects.

Transport the input presentations through the left-adjoint comparison from the reference reduction to S.reduction. Its unit equation preserves the whole-system coherence predicate. The coherent quotient-model comparison identifies their derived comparisons with strict ordinary quotient isomorphisms whose finite identifications are precisely kappaC and kappaD.

Tensor these strict quotient isomorphisms and compose with the reference strict tensor-tower comparison. On each homogeneous tensor generator the result is the tensor of the two specified quotient sections. Naturality of finite evaluation and every quotient transition proves that this is an isomorphism of strict towers.

The canonical comparison of closed tensors preserves the common tensor-Hom transpose. Its naturality and the two whole-system coherence equations identify the derived tensor-model factors with the strict tower map just constructed. Naturality and K-injective normalization of the Roos bridge give FiveStepEquation. The defining reference tensor normalization fixes its first factor to integralCompletedTensorComparison. This proves normalization of the explicitly transported realization, without any claim about arbitrary realizations or faithfulness of finite derived evaluations.
